_comment: Sentence-level cases for framework/core/content_policy.py with the electrical, electrical-year1 and medical rule sets on. expect: pass = no reject-level pattern violation; reject = the named rule must fire. Notices are not judged here (see articles.json). Written for the power-station outage niche; the negation cases are the design's own ('never backfeed' passes, 'backfeed through the dryer outlet' fails). Cases with a 'source' were added by the review rounds: review-1 / review-2 / review-3 are the reviewers' evidence sentences (review-3: concessions after a warning and spelled-out medical claims), fixer-adversarial are further evasions, fixer-legit is safety copy an author following the addendum would write (it must pass).
